I have farmed since I was a small girl and I know this soil with my hands. This plot is only 0.20 hectares, so I will use my own maize seed saved from last year and I will not waste money on new seed for it. I will put cow manure on it because it is my land, and I will also spread about half a bag of urea — the man at the cooperative said that is around 50 kilograms of nitrogen for each hectare. I do not spray chemicals on maize and there is no irrigation here; my family will work about 20 days on this plot, and I will hire a young man from the village for three days when the weeds grow thick.
